from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689749/attempts/31c36fde4a524b3f9529214b2feb9fae/system/state/workspace/programs/task-b3b030ac.py')
s='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); objs=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color=grid[r][c]
            if color and (r,c) not in seen:
                stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
                while stack:
                    y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        q=(y+dy,x+dx)
                        if 0<=q[0]<h and 0<=q[1]<w and q not in seen and grid[q[0]][q[1]]==color:
                            seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
                r0=min(y for y,x in cells); c0=min(x for y,x in cells)
                shape={(y-r0,x-c0) for y,x in cells}
                objs.append((c0,r0,color,shape,max(y for y,x in cells)-r0+1,max(x for y,x in cells)-c0+1))
    objs.sort()
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]; rr=cc=0
    for i,(_,_,color,shape,oh,ow) in enumerate(objs):
        if i:
            pr,pc,_,_,ph,pw=placed[-1]
            rr=pr+ph-1; cc=pc+pw-1
        placed.append((rr,cc,color,shape,oh,ow)) if i else None
        if i==0: placed=[(rr,cc,color,shape,oh,ow)]
        for dy,dx in shape:
            y,x=rr+dy,cc+dx
            if 0<=y<h and 0<=x<w and out[y][x]==0: out[y][x]=color
    return out
'''
p.write_text(s)
